requirement.text: The system shall generate reports on inventory levels, product movement, and sales history.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes standard business reporting functionality for inventory and sales data without any explicit web, mobile, or AI-specific features or context.

rounds.text_checked: The system shall generate reports on inventory levels, product movement, and sales history.

issues.span: reports on inventory levels, product movement, and sales history
issues.explanation: The requirement bundles three separate and independently testable reporting behaviors (inventory levels, product movement, and sales history) into a single statement.

questions.question_text: Requirement LUITEL-R7 states that the system shall generate 'reports on inventory levels, product movement, and sales history'. Should this requirement be split into three separate requirements for each distinct report type?

answers.answer_text: Keep this as one requirement. The bundled actions describe a single causal step (one trigger producing one behavior), not two independently testable behaviors -- splitting would fragment one atomic step rather than separate genuinely distinct requirements.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement outlines user-driven report generation capabilities across three report categories (inventory levels, product movement, sales history), representing multi-step user scenarios suitable for use case testing. Equivalence partitioning applies to categorize the distinct report types and test variations in underlying data presence (e.g., populated vs. empty historical data sets).

test_cases.title: Generate Inventory Levels Report for Active Stock
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in as an Inventory Manager with reporting permissions, and active stock data exists in the system.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module in the system
Select 'Inventory Levels' from the report type selector
Select filter criteria (Category: 'Electronics', Warehouse: 'Main Warehouse')
Click 'Generate Report'
test_cases.expected_result: The system generates and displays the Inventory Levels report showing current stock counts, reorder thresholds, and warehouse locations for the selected category.

test_cases.title: Generate Product Movement Report over a Specific Time Period
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with permissions to view movement reports; stock movement transactions exist within the specified date range.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module
Select 'Product Movement' from the report type selector
Specify start date '2023-01-01' and end date '2023-01-31'
Click 'Generate Report'
test_cases.expected_result: The system generates and displays the Product Movement report listing all stock inflows, transfers, and outflows during January 2023 with appropriate transaction timestamps and quantities.

test_cases.title: Generate and Export Sales History Report
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with sales reporting privileges, and historical sales transactions exist in the system.
steps: Navigate to the Reports module
Select 'Sales History' from the report type selector
Select date range 'Last Quarter'
Click 'Generate Report'
Click 'Export Report' and select 'CSV' format
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays the Sales History report summarizing total revenue, items sold, and order breakdowns for the last quarter, and successfully downloads a CSV export file containing the generated data.

test_cases.title: Report Generation for Populated vs. Empty Historical Data Partitions
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in; system contains populated sales history for Product A (Populated Partition) and no sales history for Product B (Empty Partition).
steps: Navigate to Sales History report selection screen
Generate report filtered by Product A
Verify report output
Generate report filtered by Product B
Verify report output
test_cases.expected_result: For Product A, the system returns a populated report containing detailed sales records. For Product B, the system handles the empty partition by returning an empty report layout with an informational message indicating 'No sales history found for the selected criteria'.

test_cases.title: Verification of Report Type Equivalence Partitions
test_cases.preconditions: User is logged in; system contains active inventory balances, product movement logs, and historical sales records.
steps: Request generation of Partition 1: Inventory Levels report
Request generation of Partition 2: Product Movement report
Request generation of Partition 3: Sales History report
test_cases.expected_result: Each partition produces its distinct mandatory attributes: Partition 1 outputs current stock balances and warehouse locations; Partition 2 outputs movement type, source/destination, and timestamps; Partition 3 outputs order IDs, revenue, and customer transaction details.
